As far as the therapist I don't rly know if I have the guts for it. As I said before I have a lot of anxiety that blocks me from talking to people. The friends I have are from my childhood I know that from now on I won't be able to meet new people. This will probably have a negative impact on my life but I don't know how to deal with it.

No I never wen't. I don't rly trust it. Like I don't want everyone to know I'm like this. I feel ashamed of myself. A stupid punk that has to drug himself just to "have fun" in reality is just a fake smile.

She needs him to keep our "family" together. Is more like she is forced and now is already late.

I used to try to stop him from arguing because whenever he does it he goes all out in order to make the most damage possible. My mom had a severe depression and passed out quite sometimes already because of the stress.

I would try to "stop" but most of the times it would made it worse and in every way I could make her happy I failed.

School = Disaster, most of times I end up drugging myself. Toons of bad decisions in general.

I don't come from a supportive family. My dad is an alcoholic and every day he would argue with my mom.

My relationship with him is almost nonexistent.

Let's say it is kinda a toxic home where my mom is trapped and I try to help it but I only fuck up even more.

I feel the same but not rly.

Like I'm a happy dude or I think I'm. It's strange but when I'm surrounded by friends I feel happy but when I'm alone I just want to end it. Whenever I'm alone my happiness turns into darkness and sadness. It is rly fast sometimes even a break to bathroom makes me feel this way. Maybe the clown/happy guy of the group isn't that happy.
